# deps: tools: add git-vertag

Add [git-vertag](https://github.com/kyoh86/git-vertag) to the Go toolset. **Motivation:** "extend the `gorelease` experience" — `gorelease` ([#77](DOT-76.md)) suggests the next version, `git-vertag get|major|minor|patch` reads and bumps the semantic-version tag, which is the `git patch|minor|major` idea of [#10](DOT-10.md) as an existing tool:

```bash
$  git-vertag get
v0.0.7
```
